name: Vision
overview: The Scriptures reveal that visions are a divine means by which God communicates His promises and purposes to His people, as demonstrated in the vision given to Abram in Genesis 15. In this vision, God reassures Abram of His protection and the certainty of his descendants, calling him to trust in God's faithful promise despite present circumstances. This passage highlights how vision serves as both a revelation and encouragement, confirming God's covenant and inspiring faith that is accounted as righteousness.
